Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and for the manifest/screenshot. Looping in Karthik (marketplace tech lead) and Soojin (partner ops) to help with account proofing and the preflight.

Quick next steps from our side:
1) Karthik will run the manifest through our lint/validation automation and flag schema/sku issues.
2) Soojin will coordinate publisher identity proof (we need the primary publisher email + tenant verification PDF or portal screenshot showing publisher owner).
3) If the publisher account is in "resync" state, we'll open an Azure support case on your behalf and include the tenant id and the portal error screenshot. That usually clears the status within 24–72 hours.

A few asks for you to include in reply:
- Confirm the publisher admin email (the address that owns the publisher profile)
- If you have a signed MSA or reseller letter, attach it (DocuSign link is fine).

I'll also paste our lightweight checklist so we don't miss anything:
- Tenant ID (done)
- Publisher primary email (required)
- Offer manifest (attached) – run through validation
- SKU mapping and billing plan (set in portal)
- Co-sell opt-in form (we will send link post-publish if you want co-sell)
- Support contact and pricing region mapping

We can do a short sync (15–20 min) tomorrow if you'd like — otherwise forward the publisher admin proof and the signed MSA and we'll kick off the support case.

— Vivek

Team — quick internal note after reviewing the manifest and Alex's notes:
- I ran the attached manifest through our validator: minor issues found (missing pricingCurrency code on one SKU, and a platform-compatibility tag that needs normalization). I'll prepare a diff for Alex with exact lines to patch.
- Co-sell: confirm opt-in after publish; partner ops should trigger the co-sell enrollment form once offer is published to marketplace.
- Publisher account state: per the screenshot, looks like the tenant lost publisher-owner claims when they unlinked. Soojin, please open an Azure support case (Support Request ID: TBD) with the tenant id and portal logs. Mark the case as "Publisher account resync requested" so it gets routed to Marketplace engineering.
- For reserved/dedicated SKUs: advise they include a clear quota and reservation description in the offer manifest and attach a billing plan doc. If any SKU requires additional metadata we can add an "offerNotes" blob in the metadata but prefer explicit fields.

Runbook steps I recommend (marketplace-pub-queue):
1) Attach corrected manifest and test with validator
2) Re-submit offer draft to publisher portal and watch validation job
3) If validation fails with the same schema error, escalate to Azure with validation logs
4) On success, trigger opt-in email for co-sell and notify GTM.

I'll draft the patch and send to Alex by EOD. Vivek — do you want me to own the support ticket opening or should Soojin?

Thanks,
Karthik
